body: `stash edit <stash-id>` currently allows running with no `--text/--kind/--priority` flags, which results in a no-op rewrite that still returns success. This differs from the MCP `backlogit_stash_edit` handler (which requires at least one field) and makes it easy to think an edit happened when it didnΓÇÖt. Add a preflight validation in the CLI (and/or enforce it in `core.EditStashEntry`) that errors when all three flags are empty, and add a test for that error path.

`AgeDays` is tagged with `omitempty`, so for entries created less than 24h ago the computed value is `0` and the field will be omitted even though `CreatedAt` was present. If the intent is to always expose `age_days` when `created_at` exists (including `0`), remove `omitempty` or change the field to `*int` and set it explicitly.

`AgeDays` is computed via `time.Since(*entry.CreatedAt)`, which will produce a negative value if `created_at` is in the future (clock skew, manual edits, etc.). Consider clamping the result to a minimum of 0 (or returning a validation error) to avoid returning surprising negative ages.

Update the note to reflect actual behavior so agents donΓÇÖt assume IDs/filenames change automatically.
